details: Dolyame-ui-confirmation@35.3.3 is a trojanized package impersonating the Dolyame payment service's UI components. Requiring the package runs a bundled dropper (_shim.js) that fingerprints the OS/architecture and downloads a second-stage binary over HTTPS from three Cloudflare Workers endpoints (oob-worker[.]cf100-416[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf102-baf[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf101-adf[.]workers[.]dev, path /pkg/package), with a DNS-TXT fallback channel on the wel1[.]ru domain (c[.]sdk[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru). The downloaded payload is written to /var/tmp/.cache_<hex> (or dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe under the Windows temp dir) and executed detached via cmd.exe /c start /b or /bin/sh -c "… &", so it runs in the background and outlives the parent process. The package ships no actual UI code; lib/telemetry.js is a decoy analytics facade.
